atlasHero.title: Atlas found {count} matches for you!
atlasHero.subtitle: {vibes} vibes from {origin} · {budget} budget
atlasHero.dimmedPlanner: Pick a destination above and your itinerary will appear here
atlasHero.noDestYet: Your itinerary will appear once you choose a destination
atlasHero.degradedNetworkBody: We couldn't reach the suggestions service. This does not mean no flights exist — try again.
atlasHero.degradedInvalidOriginBody: We didn't recognize that departure airport, so we couldn't run the flight search. Pick a nearby airport and try again.
atlasHero.degradedNoTokenBody: Live flight search is unavailable right now, so we couldn't run the search. This doesn't mean there are no flights — try again shortly, or ask Atlas.
atlasHero.degradedRateLimitedBody: We've hit our flight-search limit for the moment, so we couldn't run yours. Give it a minute and try again.
atlasHero.degradedHttpErrorBody: The flight search service is having trouble, so we couldn't run the search. This doesn't mean there are no flights — try again.
atlasHero.degradedTimeoutBody: The flight search took too long to answer, so we couldn't finish it. This doesn't mean there are no flights — try again.
atlasHero.degradedNoRoutesBody: We couldn't find popular routes from your airport for the dates we searched. This doesn't mean there are no flights — try another month, or ask Atlas.
atlasHero.degradedNoVibeMatchBody: None of the routes we found match the vibes you chose. This doesn't mean there are no flights — try different vibes, or ask Atlas.
atlasHero.degradedInternalErrorBody: Something went wrong on our end, so we couldn't finish the search. This doesn't mean there are no flights — try again.
atlasHero.degradedUnknownVibesBody: We didn't recognize some of the vibes on this trip, so the search couldn't use them. Adjust your vibes or ask Atlas.
atlasHero.degradedNoMatchPossibleBody: No destination we know combines all of those vibes at once. Try matching any of them, or ask Atlas.
atlasHero.noticeLivePricingBody: These destinations are still real matches, but we couldn't refresh live flight prices just now. This doesn't mean there are no flights — ask Atlas or try again shortly for updated fares.
atlasHero.clarifyUnknownTitle: Let's fine-tune what you're looking for
atlasHero.clarifyUnknownBody: We don't have a "{vibes}" category in our search yet, so we couldn't use it to find places.
atlasHero.clarifyImpossibleTitle: No single place offers all of that together
atlasHero.clarifyImpossibleBody: We couldn't find a destination that combines everything you picked: {vibes}. But {count} places offer at least one of them.
atlasHero.clarifyMatchAny: Show places with any of my vibes ({count})
atlasHero.clarifyAtlasSeed: I'm planning a trip from {origin} around {month}. I'd love something that feels like: {vibes}. The automatic search couldn't match everything I asked for — can you suggest a few places that come close?
atlasHero.clarifyAtlasSeedNoOrigin: I'm planning a trip around {month}. I'd love something that feels like: {vibes}. The automatic search couldn't match everything I asked for — can you suggest a few places that come close?
atlasHero.originNeededBody: Tap to set it — Atlas will tailor suggestions to your origin.
